note: Declared context budgets in tokens, checked by scripts/context-budget.mjs. Initial values for the maintainer to revise; they are not official counts. Rule: estimate (bytes/4 of the file with line endings normalized to LF) x (1 + margin) x 1.10, rounded up to the next multiple of 500 tokens, so each budget has at least 10 percent of headroom over the margin-adjusted estimate. margin 0.3 is applied to an offline estimate; it is our choice, inspired by the roughly 30 percent tokenizer difference in the official token counting guide, and is not a measured quantity. Revised 2026-11-24 by the same rule, still initial values for the maintainer to review, when the change fix-stacks-auditor-agent grew skill:azure-terraform-stacks (SKILL.md, about 3,472 estimated tokens) and made agent:stacks-auditor pre-load it (agent file plus SKILL.md, about 5,982 estimated tokens): 4500 -> 5000 and 2500 -> 9000. An official count is recorded under a capability as official: { model, tokens, date, bytes } (task 3.7, run by the maintainer); bytes is the LF-normalized size counted.
